name: [+ITEM SLOT] Venture Tale
desc:
DUNGEON 4, THE MANA MINES, IS FINALLY HERE! With an increased level cap to 40, there's a whole host of new items to find, experiment with, and upgrade! Fight three NEW bosses and explore the Mana Mines to discover 8 new armor sets, over 50 new weapons, a dozen new items, and 17 new spells!

Venture into different dungeons as you upgrade your gear and tailor your build to your own playstyle! Defeat hoards of enemies and epic bosses to become the strongest Venturer in the world!

Join the Group for +10% Gold!

CONTROLS
Attack - Left Click / Right Click
Rotate Camera - Middle Click
Lock Camera - Left Shift

Premium players will receive 20% more Ayagems with every purchase and have access to the Premium daily store.
